sections.heading: Leading From the Front
sections.markdown: Whether during grueling physical training, at work in garrison, or in combat, fitness establishes credibility. When a Marine can push through exhaustion, endure the elements, and set the standard, others will follow.

sections.heading: Building Cohesion Through Training
sections.markdown:
Training together fosters unit cohesion that directly enhances operational effectiveness. Struggling side by side—whether running under heavy loads, executing team-based movements, or grinding while at work—builds the trust essential for combat. This trust can be the difference between mission success and failure.

Marines who lead by example not only motivate their team; they enhance unit lethality. A unit conditioned to work as one, physically and mentally, operates with greater precision, endurance, and aggression.

sections.heading: Fitness is More Than Strength
sections.markdown:
Marine Corps fitness isn't just about strength and endurance; it's about building warriors who:

* Trust each other implicitly.
* Lead by action.
* Fight as a unified, cohesive force.

Shared struggle forges the solidarity necessary to dominate both on the battlefield and in life.

Ready to lead from the front? Push your limits, build your team, and set the standard. Train with purpose—because your strength builds unit success. Contact your local [Semper Fit](https://www.usmc-mccs.org/recreation-fitness) fitness team for continued support.
